author: feral-core
description: Execute Python/Node code and return outputs plus generated artifacts (CSV, images, files). Runs only inside the Docker sandbox: SkillExecutor refuses every endpoint with HTTP 503 when Docker is not installed or not healthy, which is the default on macOS, and a workspace grant does not substitute for it. Check that Docker is running before promising a result; when it is not, reach for coding_tools__bash inside a granted folder instead.

endpoints.description: Execute Python code in the Docker sandbox and capture generated artifacts. Refused with HTTP 503 when the Docker sandbox is unavailable; the code never runs on the host.
endpoints.returns_description: stdout, stderr, exit code, and artifact list

endpoints.description: Execute Node.js code in the Docker sandbox and capture generated artifacts. Refused with HTTP 503 when the Docker sandbox is unavailable; the code never runs on the host.
endpoints.returns_description: stdout, stderr, exit code, and artifact list
